change.title: pr-5
change.description: adding flexbox to header via mixins (all prefixes)
change.author: awesomerobot

findings.title: Small-action edit/delete buttons no longer reach the right edge
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container (264-265), so `.small-action-desc` becomes a flex item. It has no `flex-grow`, so it shrinks to the width of its content. Before this change it was a full-width block. The delete and edit `<button>`s are inside `.small-action-desc` (components/small-action.hbs:5,8) and are `float: right` (topic-post.scss:306-310), so they now float to the right edge of the shrunken description. On short notices such as "closed 3 days ago", the buttons end up right next to the text instead of at the right edge of the 755px row (desktop/topic-post.scss:730-733). Adding `flex: 1` (with prefixes) to `.small-action-desc` would bring back the old full-width box.

findings.title: Mobile custom-message `margin-left: -40px` assumes the old float layout
findings.body: mobile/topic-post.scss:520-522 gives `.custom-message` `margin-left: -40px`. With the old layout, the description started at x=0 under the floated icon, with 4em of padding, and that margin moved the message back under the icon column. Now the description is a flex item that starts after the 45px `.topic-avatar` and has only `1.5%` of padding. The negative margin pulls the message about 30px into the icon column, and `align-items: center` puts the icon in the vertical middle of the row, so the message may overlap the icon on posts that have custom text. Did you check a small-action post with custom text (for example a close with a reason) on mobile?

findings.title: `align-items` mixin sends modern values to old-syntax properties
findings.body: `-webkit-box-align` (2009 syntax) and `-ms-flex-align` (2012 syntax) accept `start`/`end`, not `flex-start`/`flex-end`. So `@include align-items(flex-start)` would produce invalid declarations for exactly the browsers these prefixes target. The current callers pass `center` and `baseline` (header.scss:18, topic-post.scss:265, badges.css.scss:57), which are valid in every syntax, so nothing is broken today. Also, `-ms-align-items` (line 121) is not a real property and can be removed. If the mixin should stay general, map `flex-start`/`flex-end` to `start`/`end` for the legacy properties.

findings.title: `margin-left: auto` does not right-align the panel under `display: -webkit-box`/`-moz-box`
findings.body: The `flexbox()` mixin falls back to the 2009 `-webkit-box`/`-moz-box` model (mixins.scss:101-102). That model does not support auto margins for pushing items along the main axis. In a browser that only understands that syntax, the header panel would sit right after the logo or topic title instead of on the right, now that the `float: right` it relied on has been removed. If those browsers matter (the prefixes suggest they do), the panel needs another way to get there there, such as `-webkit-box-flex: 1` on the item before it. If they don't, the legacy `display` values could be dropped.

contracts.action: Header `.contents` becomes a flex row; logo `.title` loses `float:left`, `.panel` loses `float:right` and uses `margin-left:auto` + order 3; `.extra-info-wrapper` gets order 2
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous float layout: `.title` float left, `.panel` float right, `.extra-info-wrapper` (overflow:hidden on desktop) filling the space between them
contracts.before_after: Before: floats; DOM order is logo, panel, extra-info. After: flex order puts logo (0), extra-info (2), panel (3), with the auto margin pushing the panel to the right. The pseudo-elements that `.clearfix` adds become zero-size flex items.
contracts.visible_effect: The header items are vertically centered. The docked topic title sits between logo and panel. Because extra-info-wrapper has overflow:hidden on desktop, its min-width is 0 and the title ellipsis still works.
contracts.failure_mode: In browsers that only understand the 2009 box syntax, auto margins don't apply, so the panel won't be right-aligned (reported as a consider finding).

contracts.action: `.small-action` becomes a flex row with centered items; description padding/margins reduced
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous layout: floated `.topic-avatar` plus a full-width block `.small-action-desc` with `padding-left: 4em`
contracts.before_after: Before: the description was full width, so the floated buttons sat at the far right. After: the description is a content-sized flex item, so the buttons sit next to the text.
contracts.visible_effect: On short small-action notices, the delete/edit buttons move next to the text. On mobile, the -40px custom-message margin may overlap the icon.

summary: The PR's title and body say it adds flexbox to the header through mixins that cover every vendor prefix. The header change itself works in modern browsers: the docked title sits between logo and panel, and the title ellipsis still works on desktop. The PR also switches `.small-action` to flexbox, and that changes its layout. The description is now content-sized, so the floated edit/delete buttons no longer reach the right edge (fix). On mobile, the description's -40px custom-message margin may now overlap the icon (question). The new mixins send modern values to old-syntax properties and emit `-ms-align-items`, which is not a real property. Under the 2009 box syntax, `margin-left: auto` won't push the panel to the right.
